{
  "up": "Select canonical_smiles, compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key
Join metabolism on metabolism.met_id = activity.met_id
Join compound_records on compound_records.record_id = metabolism.substrate_record_id
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Left Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter met_conversion is not null
Limit 200"
}
